solves.reasoning: 원문: uncomfortable feeling, helpful, powerful as shame → ③ uncomfortable-helpful-powerful
원문: effect is often positive, shame is destructive, corrodes → ② positive-destructive-corrodes
원문: guilt is about our behaviors, guilt is the motivator, believes we can change → ① behaviors-motivator-believes
④ constructive ≠ 원문 destructive. 나머지(guilty, uncomfortable, apologize) 원문 일치
③ favorable ≠ 원문 negative. behaviors, amends, corrodes 원문 일치
② worthless ≠ 원문 helpful. failed, powerful, replace 원문 일치
빈칸 위치: 'guilt is most often the ____' → motivator 원문 일치
빈칸: 'shame often is ____' → destructive. positive는 guilt 속성, powerful은 공통
빈칸: 'shame ____ the part of us' → corrodes. encourages/protects/supports는 반대 방향
guilty ≈ remorseful (양심의 가책). proud=자랑스러운, furious=격분한, relieved=안도한
replace ≈ substitute (대체). remove=제거(다름), repeat=반복, restore=복원
apologize ≈ express regret. make excuses=변명, deny responsibility=책임부인
positive ↔ harmful. beneficial/favorable/constructive는 positive 동의어
corrodes ↔ fortifies(강화). erodes/weakens/deteriorates는 corrodes 동의어
(A) failed to do = 하지 못한 (to부정사). (B) failed the exam = 불합격한 (시험)
to gradually damage or weaken = corrode. motivate/apologize/replace 무관
feel + 형용사 → guilt(명사) → guilty(형용사)
is + 형용사 보어 → destroy(동사) → destructive(형용사)
원문: apologize, make amends to others, or change → 빈칸 = make amends to
원문: believes we can change and do better → ① change and do better
